link.title: Looking for Postdoc via INNOCORE Program

entry.content:
SMS lab is looking for a postdoc in INNOCORE program, starting on January, 2026. The program fits to a postdoc candidate who is interested in AI in manufacturing. Please see this link for the details.

entry.title: ME Springboard launched on 2025 Fall
entry.content: SMS lab launches ME Springboard program in this semester. Five students from ME will work on developing flexible robotic bin picking system. They will learn how to integrate hardware like depth camera and robot into image processing, measurement and control, and deep learning.
